info.title: 同频 TONE API
info.description: MySQL-backed server. NetEase uses hana-music-api 3.2.0 programmatically on Node.js 24+; existing HTTP contracts and stored cookies are preserved. Internal-only Netease account jobs run daily at 08:00 Asia/Shanghai: Android (type=0), PC (type=1) and yunbei sign-ins run concurrently; VIP task lookup and reward claiming start only after all three attempts settle; committed playback asynchronously reports full track duration while playing. Maintenance/scrobble methods are not exposed by the HTTP proxy. See docs/NETEASE.md for bounded queues, credential gating and persisted daily attempts. Registration and login use username and password only. WebSocket protocol is documented separately in docs/API.md and docs/PROTOCOL.md. Music is stored as direct provider URLs and expiry timestamps. Room NetEase links use non-v1 song_url with br=128000 in fixed read-only batches; song_url_v1 is not allowed and is never a fallback. See docs/API.md for bounded refresh, 100 MiB bounded downloads and client-side size checks (no audio digest verification).

post.summary: 批量添加网易云歌曲，每批最多 50 首，逐首返回真实结果
post.description: 按歌曲数计入每用户每 10 分钟 200 首限流。在线成员及 enqueue 权限校验；固定内部 Hana batch 合并详情与音源读取，不接受客户端提供的上游路由、URL 或凭据。已有有效链接复用；每项独立幂等，顺序入队，非原子事务；部分成功不回滚，失败项可使用原 requestId 重试。需同步更新后端和客户端。

post.summary: 批量添加 QQ 音乐歌曲，每批最多 50 首
post.description: 客户端一次提交，服务端沿用既有 QQ 元数据接口逐项有界读取；QQ 不使用 Hana 上游 batch。在线成员、enqueue 权限、容量及逐项幂等校验，顺序入队并返回部分成功结果；按歌曲数计入每用户每 10 分钟 200 首限流。

put.description: 验证真实网易云资料后，将规范化 https://music.163.com/user?id=<ID> 写入当前已认证用户的 users.netease_profile_url 个人信息绑定字段，不保存分享追踪参数或凭据。MySQL 启动版本6幂等加列；旧 settings 引用首次读取时兼容迁移。更换/解除与旧记录清理同事务，失败保留旧绑定；null解除。按用户串行写入，不代表上游登录/所有权验证，不覆盖同频账号昵称/头像。QQ 任意主页仍返回 QQ_PUBLIC_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED 且保留旧绑定。
